message.content:
This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine dated "5-11 SEPTEMBER 2016." The red logo "TEMPO" is at the top, above the headline "ADA APA DENGAN PIZZA" in white capital letters.

The central scene depicts three people—a woman and two children—sitting at a white-clothed table eating pizza while wearing black gas masks. The woman in the center wears a white short-sleeved shirt and holds a silver knife over a plate with a pepperoni pizza slice. To her left, a person in a red long-sleeved shirt holds a pizza slice toward their mask. To her right, a person in a yellow garment does the same.

On the table sit two open red-and-white pizza boxes containing a partial pepperoni pizza, a white plate with another slice, and two red condiment bottles in the background. The background is a plain, light-grey wall. Text on the right states: "Marugame Udon dan Pizza Hut diduga pernah menggunakan bahan kedaluwarsa dalam masakan mereka. Investigasi bersama Tempo dan BBC." Additional text at the top reads: "AGAR ARCANDRA KEMBALI JADI MENTERI" and "SURVEI: SEBELAS JUTA MUSLIM INDONESIA SIAP LAKUKAN KEKERASAN."
